name: KEWAZO LIFTBOT
summary: A battery-powered lifting robot that runs up and down a rail fixed to the scaffold and carries scaffold parts and other material to the work level.

sellers.note: Lichtenbergstraße 8, 85748 Garching bei München. Service package KEWAZO CARE: training, hotline, emergency support, annual maintenance.
sellers.name: KEWAZO GmbH

germany.statusNote: Made by KEWAZO GmbH in Garching near Munich; sold on request via the maker's quote form. Pilot test units are available in Europe. No public price.

specs.label: Throughput
specs.conditions: on average per 8-hour shift with 3 people

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: product page; FAQ gives 8-10 h under heavy use

specs.label: Charging time
specs.conditions: regular 110/230 V outlet; FAQ gives 2-3 h

specs.label: Setup time
specs.conditions: done by the crew; no access bay or extra anchors needed

specs.label: Scaffold systems
specs.value: Layher, Ringlock, Cuplock, Safway, PeriUp, Kwikstage, Turner, frame and brace, tube and clamp

notes: Moves only along its rail on the scaffold or structure; it does not drive on the ground.
Runs automatically between levels without an active operator; swappable platforms for scaffold parts or general material.
Payload of a single lift is not published; the 6,000 kg figure is per shift.
Not ATEX certified; hazardous sites only after risk assessment.

KEWAZO LIFTBOT lifting unit and platform on the rail at an upper scaffold level of an industrial plant, worker reaching onto the platform

evidence.task: Moved scaffold parts during dismantling of a 52 m flare scaffold in an ATEX zone (assembly had been done by crane), plus ventilation, steel and electrical material; 30% fewer man-hours
evidence.note: Industrial scaffold on a flare, not a facade scaffold.

evidence.task: Moves scaffold parts, insulation, paint, piping and electrical material vertically

sources.title: LIFTBOT replaced a crane at BASF
